name: romsim-studio
description: Let Claude use Rom Sim Studio: assemble, disassemble, simulate and tune OKI MSM66207 Honda OBD1 ECU ROMs.
long_description:
Connects Claude to **Rom Sim Studio** (Rom Sim Studio), the toolchain for OKI MSM66207 / 66201 Honda OBD1 ECU ROMs such as the P28.

**With the desktop app open** (Settings > MCP server switched on), Claude works on the ROM that is open in the app: every calibration edit shows up live, and it can drive the simulator, the Moates Ostrich / Demon ROM emulator and datalogging to tune a car from its logs.

**Without the app**, point the extension at `romsim-mcp.exe` (or `RomSimStudio.exe`) and pick workspace folders; Claude then works on .asm / .bin files there: the architecture and opcode reference, assembler, disassembler, code explorer, cross references, table detection, calibration editing, XDF export and ROM comparison.

In **auto** mode (the default) the extension uses the app when it is running and falls back to the local server otherwise.

mode.title: Connection mode
mode.description: auto: use the desktop app when it is running, otherwise the local server below. app: always the desktop app. local: always the local server (files only).

app_url.title: Desktop app MCP address
app_url.description: Where Rom Sim Studio serves MCP (Settings > MCP server). Change the port to match, or use http://<other-pc>:<port>/mcp when the app runs on another computer with remote connections allowed.

app_password.title: Desktop app MCP password
app_password.description: The password set in Rom Sim Studio > Settings > MCP server. Leave empty if none is set (only allowed for local connections).

executable.title: Local server (romsim-mcp.exe or RomSimStudio.exe)
executable.description: Used when the desktop app is not running (auto) or always (local). romsim-mcp.exe is built from src/OkiRomSim.McpHost; RomSimStudio.exe works too (it is started with --mcp).

workspace.title: Workspace folders (local server)
workspace.description: The folders the local server may read and write (.asm, .bin, definitions, logs). Paths outside them are refused. The desktop app uses its own list from its settings.

read_only.title: Read only (local server)
read_only.description: Refuse every write: Claude can study ROMs but not change files.

tools.name: help
tools.description: List every tool with its arguments, and the recommended workflow.

tools.name: arch
tools.description: Architecture guide for the OKI MSM66207 (66K / nX-8/200) and the Honda P28 board.

tools.name: opcode
tools.description: Every encoding of an instruction: bytes, length, cycles and DD requirements, from a mnemonic, operand form or hex bytes.

tools.name: file_list
tools.description: List files in a workspace directory (non-recursive unless recursive=true).

tools.name: file_read
tools.description: Read a text file a page at a time, with line numbers.

tools.name: file_search
tools.description: Search a file (or every .asm/.inc in a directory) with a regular expression; returns matching lines with numbers.

tools.name: file_write
tools.description: Create or overwrite a text file (set overwrite=true to replace an existing file).

tools.name: workspace_roots
tools.description: The folders this server can reach, on the machine it runs on.

tools.name: workspace_allow
tools.description: Ask the user, in the desktop app, to let a folder on that machine into the workspace for this session.

tools.name: transfer_dir
tools.description: The folder on the simulator's machine that this server can always write to, and the path to give file_upload when you have nowhere else to put a file.

tools.name: app_open
tools.description: Open a file on the simulator's machine in the desktop app, as the File menu would (.asm, .bin/.rom or project .zip).

tools.name: file_download
tools.description: Read any file as base64, in chunks - how an agent on another machine gets a .bin, a log or a project out of the workspace.

tools.name: file_upload
tools.description: Write base64 into a file, in chunks - how an agent on another machine puts a .bin, .asm or definitions into the workspace.

tools.name: rom_download
tools.description: The ROM image the desktop app has open (with every calibration edit), as base64 - for an agent running on another machine.

tools.name: rom_upload
tools.description: Send a ROM image (base64) to the desktop app and open it there, as if it had been opened from disk.

tools.name: file_edit
tools.description: Replace text in a file.

tools.name: file_edit_lines
tools.description: Replace lines start_line..end_line (inclusive) with new text; end_line = start_line - 1 inserts before start_line without removing anything.

tools.name: assemble
tools.description: Assemble a .asm (syntax plus include/if/module...) into a byte-exact .bin.

tools.name: disassemble
tools.description: Disassemble a .bin/.rom image into an editable .asm.

tools.name: disassemble_range
tools.description: Show a few instructions at an address or label, with bytes, labels and source line (works on .asm and .bin).

tools.name: symbols
tools.description: Find labels/equates by name (substring or regex) or what is at an address (nearest label, source line, bytes).

tools.name: xref
tools.description: Every instruction that reads, writes, calls or jumps to an address or label.

tools.name: explore
tools.description: Follow the code from a label/address like the CPU would and report what it touches and a guess at its purpose.

tools.name: detect_tables
tools.description: Find the fuel/ignition/VE maps from the code that looks them up.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Boot the ROM in the MSM66207 simulator with a simulated engine and report what it drives.

tools.name: compare_bins
tools.description: Byte differences between two images, grouped into ranges and named by label (checks a patch changed only what was intended).

tools.name: session_info
tools.description: What the desktop app has open (ROM, build, unsaved edits, emulator, datalog).

tools.name: cal_list
tools.description: List the calibration definitions (settings, tables, axes, switches) with address, size, type and formula.

tools.name: cal_read
tools.description: Read a setting or table.

tools.name: cal_write
tools.description: Change calibration values.

tools.name: cal_scale
tools.description: Scale a whole section instead of cell by cell.

tools.name: cal_define
tools.description: Add or edit a calibration definition.

tools.name: cal_delete
tools.description: Remove a definition (the ROM bytes are not touched).

tools.name: cal_detect
tools.description: Find calibration data from the code.

tools.name: cal_explain
tools.description: Which code reads a setting or table, what that code appears to do, and the axes.

tools.name: cal_formulas
tools.description: List scaling formulas (name, expression in x, inverse, unit), or add/replace one with name + expr.

tools.name: cal_save
tools.description: Save the ROM (.bin), the definitions, or a TunerPro XDF.

tools.name: cal_features
tools.description: Code patches from a feature file (roms/features.json by default).

tools.name: compare
tools.description: What changed between two ROMs (.bin or .asm; 'session' = the app's).

tools.name: datalog
tools.description: Datalogging in the desktop app: status, start, stop, latest, frames, clear, load.

tools.name: emulator
tools.description: Moates Ostrich 2.0 / Demon ROM emulator in the desktop app: status, connect, upload, disconnect, auto upload.

tools.name: simulator
tools.description: The desktop app's simulator: run, pause, reset, step and set engine inputs.
